wordings.CACHING_EXPANSION_DESCRIPTION: The entries the cache holds for the tokens {past} of the earlier passes are loaded from the tape. The array of this pass, over its tokens {tokens}, is appended to the cache for the passes after this one, and laid after the loaded entries along the axis {past} + {tokens}, which is handed on. A token of this pass therefore stands at position |{past}| + i_{tokens} of the result. The load reads |{past}| tokens and the append writes |{tokens}|, and the load returns what the appends of the earlier passes wrote.
